[SWS_DM_02166]
SOVD
method
Write a data resource
from an Entity – data
query
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04260
⌈
If the SOVD method
Write a data resource
is received, the DM shall call the
corresponding
GenericDiagnosticSovdContent::Write
method with the
Diag-
nosticSovdContentData
data created with:
•
DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::SetName
with the
shortName
of the
DiagnosticSovdContentElement
•
DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::SetContent
with the
value
derived from the conversation rules defined in Chapter 7.3.3.3.2 “SOVD
Data – Conversion”.
⌋
7.3.3.5.2 SOVD API – Configuration
The ASAM SOVD[5] standard generally supports two different approaches for the
API
Methods for Configuration
:
•
Configurations as parameter
, using
MIME type application/json
with defined
Response Body
structure.
•
Configurations as bulk-data
, using bulk like
MIME types
, such as
application/octet-stream
.
For the realization of these SOVD
API Methods for Configuration
two different
approaches have been realized:
• Configurations as parameter derived from
DiagnosticSovdContent
under us-
age of
DiagnosticSovdConfigContentMapping
.
•
Configurations as parameter
or
Configurations as bulk-data
re-
alized explicitly by modelling and using the dedicated
ara::diag::SovdCon-
figuration::SovdConfiguration
Interface
